lines.text: I came here to learn English.
Many learners say: I came here for learn English.
Better: I came here to learn English.
Before a verb, we say to.
To! I study to get a job.

data.wrong: I came here for learn English.
data.right: I came here to learn English.
data.why: Before a verb, we say to.

quiz.stem: I study English ___ get a better job.

native.tip: En français, on dit « pour apprendre ». En anglais, devant un verbe, on dit “to”, pas “for”.
